About.title: About Eutech
About.intro: Eutech is a software company building practical, operational software for healthcare businesses.
About.philosophy: We build software around how clinics actually operate day to day, starting with the operational basics — registration, queueing, consultation, dispensing and reporting — rather than adding features clinics don't need yet.
About.focus: Eutech's first product, Eutech Clinic, focuses on day-to-day clinic operations. We are a software company beginning with clinic operations, not a one-off project — the platform is built to support additional Eutech products over time.

eutechClinic.title: Eutech Clinic
eutechClinic.subtitle: Everything a clinic needs to manage a patient visit, in English and Simplified Chinese.

sections.title: Patient registration
sections.description: Register new patients and retrieve returning patients quickly at reception.

sections.title: Appointments and queue management
sections.description: Manage walk-ins and scheduled appointments in a single queue view.

sections.title: Doctor-room assignment and assigned queues
sections.description: Route patients to the right doctor room and let doctors work through their own queue.

sections.title: Consultation workflow
sections.description: Capture consultation notes in a structured workflow designed for clinic visits.

sections.title: Prescriptions
sections.description: Doctors write prescriptions directly into the patient's visit record.

sections.title: Dispensing, including partial dispensing
sections.description: Dispensers fill prescriptions against live stock, including partial dispensing when needed.

sections.title: Medicine inventory
sections.description: Track stock levels and batches so shortages are visible before they become a problem.

sections.title: Roles and permissions
sections.description: Give staff access appropriate to their role — reception, doctor, dispenser or administrator.

sections.title: Reporting
sections.description: Administrators get visibility into clinic activity and operations.

sections.title: Patient-facing QR queue status
sections.description: Patients check their place in line from their own phone using a QR code.

sections.title: English/Chinese interface
sections.description: Staff and patients can use the interface in English or Simplified Chinese.

sections.title: Onboarding and support
sections.description: New clinics are guided through setup, with support available once you're live.
